assets.name: sowing-seed
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: a single square illustrated action card for a parent-child thinking game. Input image is a STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE: the orange kitten planting story atlas. Create ONLY ONE standalone square panel, NOT a collage, improving the sowing step. Keep the same cute orange tabby kitten, soft detailed children's book rendering, warm off-white paper background, terracotta flowerpot and green seed bowl. Show the pot ALREADY FULL OF SOIL. Make the action completely unmistakable: the kitten pinches one large pale bean seed directly above a small hole in the soil, placing it into the hole; one additional bean visibly rests partly inside the hole. Its other paw holds the pot rim. A small green bowl with a few seeds may be beside it. No pouring soil, no watering can, no sprout, no other animals, no labels, no arrows, no numbers. Three-quarter close view, whole kitten upper body and pot fully visible, central action large enough for a small card, generous clean margins. Preserve character identity and painterly texture from the supplied reference. Output a single square PNG illustration on opaque warm off-white background.
assets.reason: Replace planting action frame only; bean visibly enters soil.

assets.name: box-closed
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: single object picture card for a children's antonym matching game, word CLOSED. Create one square illustration showing a small plain teal-blue wooden storage box with a hinged lid COMPLETELY CLOSED, lid lying flush with its rim. Front and right side visible in a gentle three-quarter view, eye-level slightly above the box. Rounded child-friendly corners, one simple small round wooden handle on the front, no lock, no clasp. Soft detailed painterly children's-book illustration, subtle wood texture, restrained soft shadow, warm off-white opaque background. Center the full box with ample margin, object occupies about 65% width and 50% height, at center of square. NO person, hands, animals, toys, arrows, labels, words, logos, symbols or extra objects. The state of the lid is the only semantic clue; there must be no gap, no visible interior. This image will be paired with the exact same box OPEN; keep plain simple invariant design for accurate matching.
assets.reason: Antonym word card: closed hinged box.

assets.reason: Same object with open lid; no unrelated cues.
